supersedes_invalid_audit: V1 reported fresh_coverage before setting any cache entry fresh; no environment or gate parameter was changed in V2.

gates.E1_non_saturated_baseline: The static split policy mean coverage is strictly between 0.10 and 0.90.
gates.E2_age_changes_oracle_choice: At least one matched-geometry cache-age counterfactual changes the one-step oracle's unique joint assignment.
gates.E3_switching_has_cost_and_value: The one-step oracle switches in at least 0.05 and at most 0.80 of decisions, and disabling blackout changes its mean coverage by at least 0.02.
gates.E4_native_actor_visible_staleness: Matched geometry with fresh versus expired local cache produces different coverage while positions and assignments are equal.
gates.E5_distinguishable_reference_ladder: The oracle exceeds the best non-oracle rule by at least 0.03 mean coverage, and the best non-oracle rule is above 0.10.

stop_rule: If any E1-E5 gate fails, close P39. Do not tune ranges, speeds, cache duration, blackout duration, seeds, rewards, or thresholds after observing the output.
